blocks.title: Asaan alfaaz mein
blocks.text: Sahi stationary aur mobile phase chunna zaroori hai: components tabhi alag hote hain jab stationary phase unhein mobile phase ke muqable mein mukhtalif mazbooti se pakre. Maslan polar cheezein alumina jaise polar stationary phase par mazbooti se chipakti hain, is liye kam polar solvent se unhein non-polar cheezon se alag kiya ja sakta hai.

blocks.prompt: Mixture mein har volatile ester ka hissa napna ho to kaun si chromatography istemal karenge, aur kyun?
blocks.explanation: Gas chromatography: yeh volatile compounds ko jaldi alag karti hai aur quantitative hai, kyunke peaks ke areas har component ka hissa batate hain.
